Hubble App Lists Discounted Gift Cards for Existing Users, Forum Reports

01 Nov 2026, 06:34 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.desidime.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysThe post notes that some deals require unlocking within the app, while others already appear as "Claimed." Offer availability may change without notice.

Reported Offers

A discussion thread on Desidime, an Indian deal-sharing community, reports that the Hubble App is featuring a "Deal of the Day" section with discounted gift cards from several brands. According to the forum post, the following offers were listed at the time of writing:

  • MakeMyTrip Rail ₹100 Gift Card – 70% off
  • Amazon Pay ₹10 Gift Card – 90% off
  • MakeMyTrip Bus ₹200 Gift Card – 70% off

The post notes that some deals require unlocking within the app, while others already appear as "Claimed." Offer availability may change without notice.

Eligibility and Access

The forum post states the promotion is currently for existing (old) users of the Hubble App. Users without an account are advised to create one and keep it active, as "different brands keep offering deals on this app." No further eligibility criteria (such as region, KYC status, or minimum transaction history) are specified in the source.

Important Caveats

  • Source nature: The information originates from a user-generated forum discussion, not an official Hubble App announcement or press release.
  • Discounts, not freebies: All listed items are discounted gift cards requiring payment; none are described as free.
  • No verified redemption link: The post includes a truncated Google Play Store link (`https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=m...`) but no direct deep-link to the specific offers.
  • Unconfirmed details: Stock limits, expiration dates, shipping fees, auto-renewal terms, and whether a paid Hubble membership is required are not mentioned in the source.

How to Verify

  1. Install the Hubble App from the Google Play Store (search "Hubble" or use the partial link above).
  2. Log in with an existing account or create a new one.
  3. Navigate to the "Deal of the Day" or equivalent section inside the app to see current offers.
  4. Check each deal’s terms before purchasing, as forum-reported prices and availability may be outdated.
  5. For official communications, monitor Hubble’s verified website, in-app notifications, or social media channels.
